_comment: Reviewed exceptions to the dependency audits in .gnomon/ci.sh (pip-audit-backend,
pip-audit-packages, npm-audit), read by scripts/dep_audit.py. An advisory the audit reports
fails the gate unless an entry here names it. Each entry: id (the advisory id or an alias,
e.g. PYSEC-..., GHSA-..., CVE-...), ecosystem (pypi | npm), package, reason (why it cannot
be fixed now and why it does not reach this codebase), review_by (YYYY-MM-DD). An entry past
review_by fails, and so does one whose advisory is no longer reported (strike it off).
2026-09-25: empty. Every advisory reported against the backend and kernel environments and
package-lock.json was fixed by raising a floor or upgrading (backend/pyproject.toml,
frontend/package.json, the root package.json's overrides); python-jose, unused, was removed
with its ecdsa dependency, whose CVE-2024-23342 has no fix upstream.
2026-10-14: braces (GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm) allowlisted; next, sharp, shell-quote and source-map-js
were fixed by upgrading (next 15.5.27, sharp 0.35.5 pinned in the frontend's optionalDependencies).

2026-10-31: minimatch (GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249, published 2026-10-30) allowlisted; next (GHSA-2464-fhr4-w9xw, GHSA-p3m5-59mp-jv5r), @vitest/mocker (GHSA-qxg6-89mg-rqv8, GHSA-xp26-3454-mjgp) and zod (GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5), all published after main was last gated, were fixed by upgrading (next 16.4.3, vitest 5.0.5, zod 4.6.7). braces (GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm) is struck off: GitHub withdrew the advisory on 2026-10-23 and npm audit no longer reports it (braces 3.0.3 is still in the tree, through @next/eslint-plugin-next -> fast-glob 3.3.1 -> micromatch).

entries.reason: The only patched release is minimatch 11.0.1, published 2026-10-27 and inside a major whose CommonJS export is no longer the callable function the 3.x line exports; nothing in the lint toolchain has moved to it. The tree holds minimatch 3.1.5 (eslint 9.39 and @eslint/eslintrc, @eslint/config-array 0.21, eslint-plugin-import 2.32.0, eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y 6.10.2, eslint-plugin-react 7.37.5 -- each the latest release, each on ^3.1.2) and 10.2.6 (@typescript-eslint/typescript-estree 8.72.1, latest, on ^10.2.2), and an override to 11 would break the ^3 callers. Every path is a lint-time devDependency (npm ls minimatch --omit=dev is empty), so it is not in the frontend image, and the globs it expands are this repository's own ESLint config and file patterns, not untrusted input. Leaves when eslint and its plugins move to a patched minimatch (septa-130).
